# The complexity ratchet's baseline (see complexity_test.go): every function under cmd/ and
# internal/ that scores above 15, with its score, written when the ratchet was added.
# One function a line: the score, the file and the function, separated by tabs, sorted by
# file and then function.
#
# This file only shrinks. A function that falls is lowered here (and deleted at 15 or
# below); a function that rises, or one that is new and above 15, fails the test and is
# split. Nothing here is raised or added by hand without the owner's ruling, and no flag
# rewrites it.
#
# Score: 1, plus 1 for each if, for, range, case of a switch or select other than default,
# && and ||; a function literal counts toward the function that holds it. This is the rule
# of gocyclo, which VIGIL ran with min-complexity 15.
